want: to set a day-precise custom date range on Insights and filter it by more than one wallet at once
soThat: I can see a combined spending report for a non-calendar cycle (e.g. a salary month running 26th to 25th) across the wallets I actually use, such as my main Bangkok Bank account plus occasional Mandiri CC spending
acceptance: the Custom period preset shows day-precise From and To date inputs instead of whole-month selection
the wallet filter allows selecting more than one wallet at once, in addition to a single wallet or All wallets
when multiple wallets are selected, income/expenses/category totals combine across just those wallets, split by currency
the custom date range and the wallet selection combine with each other and both persist when the other changes
selecting no wallets behaves the same as All wallets
